name: product-capability-release-lineage
title: Product capability release records + playbook capability lineage binding (M0-M8)
description:
Implement the product-capability-release-playbook-lineage execution plan (docs/requirements/decisions/product-capability-release-playbook-lineage-execution-plan.md), milestones M0 through M8.

Problem: B-785e produced an artifact release (AR-4e885ed0209e5a32330cdc33) and a candidate playbook (PBP-882), but PBP-882's lineage carries only sourceStoryId/sourceFindingId/sourceSignature=done_experience. It lacks a first-class capabilityReleaseId / artifactReleaseId binding, so future hosts cannot answer which reusable product capability version a lesson is about, or which artifact digest backs it.

Fix (parallel to the existing artifact-release feature): add a non-runtime ProductCapabilityReleaseRecord ledger, a conservative DONE capability classifier, deterministic idempotent release binding, DONE candidate-ingest lineage attachment, read-only inspection CLI, controlled pending-learning candidate exposure, evidence-based outcome/promotion safety (DONE success alone never counts as helped), and an idempotent B-785e backfill.

Safety boundary preserved throughout: capability releases are authority=non_authoritative, gateEvidence=false; candidate playbooks stay inert (never auto-active, never in MemoryFreshnessPack active playbookIds, never gate evidence); promotion requires concrete exposure + structured verdict.
